messages:
Ellen: p99 spike in usw1 since 06:10 UTC. looks like tenant 'batch-hub' started a multi-node warmup. kvcache regen + host egress high. anyone free?

Priya: I'm on. saw NIC tx queueing and a jump in warm-slot evictions. If we don't act, more tenants will see tail latency.

Marco: Quick options: (1) soft-quarantine + egress cap, (2) tiny dedicated slice with egress limit, (3) route their staged work to preemptible pool. Soft-quarantine is fastest.

Ellen: Agreed. apply an egress policer first and enable fallback routing. Keep duration short (1h) and notify tenant.

Priya: Running:
```n/rwdctl tenant update batch-hub --egress-limit 140mbps --soft-quarantine true --quarantine-ttl 60m --fallback preemptible``n
Will also add nic-shaper on impacted hosts.

ops-bot: Created INF-4807: "batch-hub warmup -> egress cap + soft quarantine". Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/noisy-tenant-mitigation

Marco: Monitor kvcache_evictions and p99. If p99 doesn't improve in 10m, we should carve 2 GPUs for them with strict egress.

Priya: Patch applied. initial telemetry: p99 down ~16%, kvcache evictions down ~35%, small percentage routed to preemptible fallback.

Ellen: Good. leave quarantine and reinspect at 30m. Also open a short RFC for a burst-credit model so scheduled large jobs don't impact shared slot health.
